# google_apihub_addon

Addons are used to configure value-added services inside the API Hub.


To get more information about Addon, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/reference/apis/apihub/rest/v1/projects.locations.addons)
* How-to Guides
    * [Manage add-ons](https://cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/apihub/manage-add-ons)
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/apihub/what-is-api-hub)


## Example Usage - Apihub Addon Basic


```hcl
resource "google_project" "project" {
  project_id      = "apihub-proj"
  name            = "apihub-proj"
  org_id          = "123456789"
  billing_account = "000000-0000000-0000000-000000"
  deletion_policy = "DELETE"
}

resource "time_sleep" "wait_60_seconds" {
  create_duration = "60s"
  depends_on      = [google_project.project]
}

resource "google_project_service" "apihub_service" {
  project            = google_project.project.project_id
  service            = "apihub.googleapis.com"
  disable_on_destroy = false
  depends_on         = [time_sleep.wait_60_seconds]
}

# An API hub instance requires a host project registration in the same location.
resource "google_apihub_host_project_registration" "host_project_registration" {
  project                      = google_project.project.project_id
  location                     = "us-central1"
  host_project_registration_id = google_project.project.project_id
  gcp_project                  = "projects/${google_project.project.project_id}"

  depends_on = [google_project_service.apihub_service]
}

# Provisioning an API hub instance creates the system-defined addons and plugins.
resource "google_apihub_api_hub_instance" "apihub_instance" {
  project  = google_project.project.project_id
  location = "us-central1"

  config {
    disable_search = true
  }

  timeouts {
    create = "60m"
  }

  depends_on = [google_apihub_host_project_registration.host_project_registration]
}

resource "google_apihub_addon" "apihub_addon_basic" {
  project  = google_project.project.project_id
  location = "us-central1"
  addon_id = "system-specboost"

  config {
    all_data_addon_config {
      enabled = true
    }
  }

  depends_on = [google_apihub_api_hub_instance.apihub_instance]
}
```

## Example Usage - Apihub Addon Gateway Plugin


```hcl
resource "google_project" "project" {
  project_id      = "apihub-proj"
  name            = "apihub-proj"
  org_id          = "123456789"
  billing_account = "000000-0000000-0000000-000000"
  deletion_policy = "DELETE"
}

resource "time_sleep" "wait_60_seconds" {
  create_duration = "60s"
  depends_on      = [google_project.project]
}

resource "google_project_service" "apihub_service" {
  project            = google_project.project.project_id
  service            = "apihub.googleapis.com"
  disable_on_destroy = false
  depends_on         = [time_sleep.wait_60_seconds]
}

# An API hub instance requires a host project registration in the same location.
resource "google_apihub_host_project_registration" "host_project_registration" {
  project                      = google_project.project.project_id
  location                     = "us-central1"
  host_project_registration_id = google_project.project.project_id
  gcp_project                  = "projects/${google_project.project.project_id}"

  depends_on = [google_project_service.apihub_service]
}

# Provisioning an API hub instance creates the system-defined addons and plugins.
resource "google_apihub_api_hub_instance" "apihub_instance" {
  project  = google_project.project.project_id
  location = "us-central1"

  config {
    disable_search = true
  }

  timeouts {
    create = "60m"
  }

  depends_on = [google_apihub_host_project_registration.host_project_registration]
}

resource "google_apihub_plugin_instance" "plugin_instance" {
  project            = google_project.project.project_id
  location           = "us-central1"
  plugin             = "system-edge-public-cloud"
  plugin_instance_id = "edge-plugin-instance"
  display_name       = "Test Edge Public Cloud Plugin Instance"
  source_project_id  = "edge-org"

  actions {
    action_id = "sync-metadata"
  }

  actions {
    action_id = "sync-runtime-data"
  }

  depends_on = [google_apihub_api_hub_instance.apihub_instance]
}

resource "google_apihub_addon" "apihub_addon_gateway_plugin" {
  project  = google_project.project.project_id
  location = "us-central1"
  addon_id = "system-advanced-api-security"

  config {
    gateway_plugin_addon_config {
      gateway_plugin_configs {
        plugin_instance = google_apihub_plugin_instance.plugin_instance.id
        apigee_edge_config {
          environment_filter {
            all_environments = false
            environments     = ["test"]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `config` -
  (Required)
  The configuration of the addon.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config).

* `location` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `addon_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the addon.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_config"></a>The `config` block supports:

* `gateway_plugin_addon_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for gateway plugin addons.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config).

* `all_data_addon_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for addons which act on all data in the API hub.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_all_data_addon_config).


<a name="nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config"></a>The `gateway_plugin_addon_config` block supports:

* `gateway_plugin_configs` -
  (Required)
  The list of gateway plugin configs for which the addon is enabled.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs).


<a name="nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs"></a>The `gateway_plugin_configs` block supports:

* `plugin_instance` -
  (Required)
  The name of the gateway plugin instance for which the config is to be specified.
  Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/plugins/{plugin}/instances/{instance}

* `apigee_x_hybrid_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid gateways.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_x_hybrid_config).

* `apigee_edge_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for Apigee Edge gateways.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_edge_config).

* `apigee_opdk_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for Apigee OPDK gateways.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_opdk_config).


<a name="nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_x_hybrid_config"></a>The `apigee_x_hybrid_config` block supports:

* `environment_filter` -
  (Optional)
  The filter to apply on the resources managed by the gateway plugin instance.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_x_hybrid_config_environment_filter).


<a name="nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_x_hybrid_config_environment_filter"></a>The `environment_filter` block supports:

* `all_environments` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates if this filter should match all environments or only a subset of environments.

* `environments` -
  (Optional)
  If provided, only environments in this list are matched.

<a name="nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_edge_config"></a>The `apigee_edge_config` block supports:

* `environment_filter` -
  (Optional)
  The filter to apply on the resources managed by the gateway plugin instance.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_edge_config_environment_filter).


<a name="nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_edge_config_environment_filter"></a>The `environment_filter` block supports:

* `all_environments` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates if this filter should match all environments or only a subset of environments.

* `environments` -
  (Optional)
  If provided, only environments in this list are matched.

<a name="nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_opdk_config"></a>The `apigee_opdk_config` block supports:

  The filter to apply on the resources managed by the gateway plugin instance.

<a name="nested_config_gateway_plugin_addon_config_gateway_plugin_configs_apigee_opdk_config_environment_filter"></a>The `environment_filter` block supports:

* `all_environments` -

<a name="nested_config_all_data_addon_config"></a>The `all_data_addon_config` block supports:

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/addons/{{addon_id}}`

* `name` -
  Identifier. The name of the addon. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/addons/{addon}`.

* `display_name` -
  The display name of the addon.

* `description` -
  The description of the addon.

* `data_source` -
  The data source on which the addon operates.

* `create_time` -
  The time at which the addon was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time at which the addon was last updated.

* `state` -
  The state of the addon.

* `boost_spec_gemini_region_id` -
  The Vertex AI region where the BoostSpec Gemini model calls run for this API Hub instance.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 60 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 60 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Addon can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/addons/{{addon_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{addon_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{addon_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Addon using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    addonId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_apihub_addon.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Addon using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/addons/{{addon_id}}"
  to = google_apihub_addon.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Addon can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_apihub_addon.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/addons/{{addon_id}}
$ terraform import google_apihub_addon.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{addon_id}}
$ terraform import google_apihub_addon.default {{location}}/{{addon_id}}
```
